messages:
maria: @here seeing sustained apiserver keepalive RTT spikes in eu-west1 since ~03:12 UTC. controller-manager failing lease renewals, gpu node autoscaler is reacting to node flaps. anyone oncall can take a look? :eyes:

sre-oncall-bot: [ALERT] apiserver.keepalive.rtt high (eu-west1) — INC-3421 created and paged.

chris: grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/apiserver-latency?org=1 — big 100-200ms spikes at 03:12-03:14, repeated bursts.

maria: logs from controller-manager around the spike:
```
I0315 03:12:45.123 1 leaderelection.go:253] failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
W0315 03:12:45.124 1 controller_utils.go:412] work queue appears to be stalled
```

oliver: preliminary tcpdump on the proxy in eu-west1 shows repeated RSTs to client keepalive windows on port 6443, looks like proxy/LB dropping long-lived connections.

jun: did we have a rollout in eu-west1 around 03:08? LB config change maybe?

maria: infra-deploy-bot shows `infra/lb-config` rollout at 03:09 for eu-west1. @chris can you check if that overlapped the spike?

chris: yep, saw that. starting rollback of lb flags and restarting proxy gw pods (canary 2/8) now.

sre-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: rollback infra/lb-config@v2 -> initiated by chris.

oliver: after restarting the canary proxy pods RTT improved but we still see ~10s microbursts of high keepalive RTT. suggests LB path intermittently dropping tcp keepalives.

jun: short mitigation idea — bump apiserver keepalive/timeout to 60s (current 15s) to reduce leader election churn while we fully validate LB rollback. also consider pausing cluster-autoscaler to avoid GPU churn.

maria: pausing autoscaler now: `kubectl annotate deployment cluster-autoscaler cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/paused=true` :white_check_mark:  (applied to eu-west1 cluster).

chris: lb rollback completed, restarted all proxy pods in gw-eu-west1. monitoring shows majority of connections stable; keepalive RTT back to baseline after ~2m.

maria: controller-manager renewed lease and leader election stabilized. no new pod evictions observed for the last 8m.

jun: note — during the 10m window autoscaler churn caused ~2.5 GPU-hours of extra spend (nodes spun up then drained). filing cost ticket.

maria: filing COST-987 for the spend spike, linking INC-3421. will add details to incident doc and runbook.

oliver: follow-ups: 1) add active keepalive probes from proxies to apiserver (and alerting), 2) add LB rollout gating to prevent single-region flag flips, 3) tune autoscaler cooldown and add pause-on-controlplane-degradation.

maria: agreed. will create follow-up tasks and assign. thanks all for the quick response. :thumbsup:

chris: one-liner for postmortem: LB flag rollout caused intermittent TCP resets on apiserver path -> keepalive RTT spikes -> controller-manager lease renewals failed -> autoscaler reacted -> GPU churn and cost spike. rollback + proxy restarts mitigated.

maria: closing thread once incident doc updated.
